source_clause: PVALSPK3.) If the SPAAK user presses the Profiles icon with the lock, popup PU1573 will display.
leaf_desc_037: PVALSPK3.) If the SPAAK user presses the Profiles icon with the lock, popup PU1573 will display.
reasoning: 驗證目標：13.3（PVALSPK3）—— SPAAK 使用者按下帶鎖之 Profiles 圖示時顯示 PU1573。關鍵情境條件：帶鎖之圖示即 12.5 所述之呈現，本條以其為操作對象。為什麼這樣切：非 SPAAK 情境下按同一圖示之行為屬 12.6（PU 不同），兩者之 pre-condition 互斥。刻意略過：PU1573 之內文未載於 spec，本 TC 只驗其顯示（同 R-U27 之處置）。

tcs.tc_title: PU1573 shown when the SPAAK user presses the locked icon
tcs.test_item: PU1573 shown when the SPAAK user presses the locked icon
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. Valet Mode is active under the SPAAK scenario
2. The user at the head unit is the SPAAK user
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the Profiles icon with the lock in the status bar
2. Read the screen and check that PU1573 is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Profiles icon with the lock is pressed
2. PU1573 is displayed
tcs.priority_basis: SPAAK 下按 Profile 圖示之提示（PU1573）
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
